sentences.en: Abraham Lincoln was buried in his hometown of Springfield, Illinois.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕·林肯被安葬在他位于伊利诺伊州斯普林菲尔德的家乡。

sentences.en: I ate potato flavoured village bread in my hometown, Bolu.
sentences.zh: 我在我的家乡博卢吃了一种用土豆调味的乡村面包。

sentences.en: If you ever go to Japan, please visit my hometown.
sentences.zh: 如果你去日本，请务必参观一下我的家乡。
